title: Lists & Statistics tab and CAS algebra/calculus API

features.notes: Wire the Lists & Statistics tab to /api/lists, /api/stats/onevar and /api/stats/regression; draw only what the API returns. Load lists on page load and tab open. Draw points and curve on stats-canvas from the API arrays. Add a real-browser test for both owner checks. Keep P33 wrapping; leave Calculator and Graphs code alone.

Add a CAS module and the /api/cas/simplify, /expand and /factor routes. Parse input with the calculator's restricted grammar so names and literals are handled as in P23, P24 and P27. Write powers with ^. A malformed expr returns 400 with a JSON error, never a 500.

Add derivative, integral and limit to the CAS module. lower, upper and point accept a number or an expression string such as pi or oo. dir is + or -, and anything else returns 400. Guard against hangs, as in P28.
Add solve. Split the equation on a single '='; with no '=', the expression is taken to equal 0. Return the solutions as sorted exact strings, including complex ones. A missing var returns 400.
